# MIHORA.TECH — Sovereign Engineering & Datacenter Infrastructure

> MIHORA.TECH is an international sovereign engineering organization operating synchronized command hubs across London (United Kingdom) and Islamabad (Pakistan). Built on architectural determinism, MIHORA delivers full-spectrum technology systems spanning mission-critical distributed backends, enterprise datacenter construction, optical fiber certification, automated SCADA/workflow pipelines, and 24/7 site reliability engineering.

## Executive Leadership & Founders
- **M. Matti ul Hasnain** (Matti ul Hasnain, Muhammad Matti ul Hasnain, Hasnain): Co-Founder & Principal Systems Architect. Directs sovereign systems architecture, the 9-layer technology stack, physical datacenter hardware topologies, core-alignment fusion fiber splicing (loss <= 0.05 dB), and 24/7 SRE reliability protocols.
- **Omema Iqbal** (Omema): Co-Founder & Operations Director. Directs global dual-hub operational governance across London and Islamabad, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Type II compliance alignment, executive client stewardship, and international delivery.

## Five Core Engineering Divisions
1. **Digital Systems Engineering** (`https://mihora.tech/services/digital-engineering/`): High-concurrency Go/TypeScript microservices, zero-trust API meshes, fault-tolerant PostgreSQL/Kafka consensus clusters (99.999% SLA).
2. **Automation & Intelligence** (`https://mihora.tech/services/automation-intelligence/`): Deterministic event-driven orchestration, industrial SCADA telemetry bridges, air-gapped one-way optical diodes, and audited workflow routing.
3. **Physical Datacenter Infrastructure** (`https://mihora.tech/services/physical-infrastructure/`): Tier-III/IV 42U/48U server rack deployment, NVMe-oF SAN fabrics, core-alignment fusion fiber splicing (<= 0.03-0.05 dB), Cat6A shielded cable dressing, and hot/cold aisle containment.
4. **Field Engineering & Dispatch** (`https://mihora.tech/services/field-engineering/`): Rapid regional on-site deployment rigs, bidirectional EXFO OTDR & Fluke DSX-8000 certification, and 4-hour emergency hardware break-fix SLA.
5. **Managed Reliability (24/7 SRE)** (`https://mihora.tech/services/managed-sre/`): Synchronized follow-the-sun continuous telemetry monitoring across London (UTC+0) and Islamabad (UTC+5) NOC clusters with <15-minute Tier-3 response.
